title: I Have a Garden
summary: One zucchini, 48 real days. It keeps growing while the app is closed. From December 1, overripe tomatoes turn into Christmas baubles. One zucchini plant. 48 real days. Here the game's time is your time. You water it tonight and by tomorrow the soil will be a little drier. It gets light and dark at the same time as it does outside your window. The stems, the leaves and the flowers are drawn by an algorithm that imitates how a plant really grows. No two games give you the same shape, or the same harvest. Once you have the zucchini figured out, try the tomato plant: twice the days, up to twenty tomatoes, suckers to prune and a plant that climbs tied to its stake. It brings its own seeds, its own chimera tomato and new achievements. And for a third challenge, the pepper plant: 72 days, and snails that climb the stem to eat its leaves and peppers, which you pick off with your gloves. Each pepper turns from green to yellow to red, and you have to pick it at the right moment. It brings its own chimera pepper, its own seeds and new achievements. You unlock it with a single purchase, which also removes the ads. All three plants grow at the same time, each in its own plot. WHAT YOU'LL DO You check on it, water or feed it if it's time, look for pests and pull the odd weed. For as long as you feel like. HOW THE CYCLE GOES You start by preparing the soil and burying the seed. Until flowering you have to look after it as well as you can, because that stretch decides how many flowers open. When they do, the bees arrive to pollinate them, and if you've kept it up, every one sets fruit. The last stretch takes the most attention: each zucchini has its right moment, and picking it early or leaving it too long costs you points. IMPROVE YOUR PLANT When the cycle ends, you can take the seeds out of the Prime and Overripe zucchini you harvested. There are four qualities: Wild, Adapted, Selected and Heirloom. The better the seed, the more main branches the stem puts out. That raises your chances of getting a chimera zucchini, the hardest thing in the game to pull off. ACHIEVEMENTS There are twenty-seven achievements to earn along the way, gardener's ranks among them: when you gather the harvest you get a score and the rank you earned with the plant. WHAT IT DOESN'T DO No account, no email. No lives, no paying your way forward: the only purchase is the pepper plant, and it's optional. No leaderboard, nobody to beat. And it doesn't message you for the sake of it: a notification arrives when the plant actually needs something, at most one a day, not every evening at seven. It's free and kept going by advertising. If you'd rather support it another way, the pepper purchase removes the ads for good. ALSO You can put a widget on your home screen with the water and feed gauges, without opening the game. A notebook inside that explains every mechanic with real numbers, if you want to know why. A daily graph of water, feed and pests since the day you planted the seed. And a few more surprises. Thank you for playing.

title: ScribbleGrid: Word Search
summary: Word search at its most satisfying! Read the clue, figure out the word, then swipe across the grid to find it. Every word you find reveals a letter of the Secret Word — crack it before you finish the grid! THE SECRET WORD: A NEW LAYER ON WORD SEARCH Every puzzle hides a Secret Word. Each word you find reveals one of its letters. Guess it before the grid is done: the earlier you crack it, the bigger the bonus. You get 3 guesses! DAILY PUZZLE One puzzle a day, the same for everyone — including the same Secret Word. Keep your streak, share your result with a spoiler-free emoji card and climb the daily Game Center leaderboard. NO WORD LIST, JUST CLUES The words aren't handed to you — you work them out from clues. They hide horizontally, vertically, diagonally, even backwards. PLAY WITH VOICEOVER ScribbleGrid can be played from start to finish with VoiceOver. Clues and grid letters are read aloud; mark a word by double-tapping its first and last letters. Hear a whole row, column or diagonal at once, and hear every letter as you type the Secret Word. A step-by-step VoiceOver guide is built into the game. COMBO SCORING Find words within 10 seconds of each other to push your multiplier up to x5. THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS Easy: short words, straight directions. Medium: reversed directions join in. Hard: long words in all 8 directions. STATS AND STREAK REMINDERS Track your streak, best times and solved Secret Words. If the puzzle is still waiting, get an optional reminder at 8 PM. TWO LANGUAGES, THOUSANDS OF WORDS Thousands of carefully written clues in English and Turkish. Great for language learners too. PLAY ANYWHERE A 10x10 grid on iPhone, a huge 15x15 grid on iPad. No internet needed — play on a plane, on the subway, anywhere. NO ADS There are no ads in the game. ScribbleGrid Pro adds unlimited hints, 2x coin rewards and instant solve in classic mode — a one-time purchase, no subscription. If you love word games, puzzles and brain teasers, ScribbleGrid is made for you. Download now and crack today's Secret Word!

title: Guest House
summary: Guest House: a free Mac app for running Windows and Linux with VoiceOver, no sighted help Hi everyone, I want to tell you about a free Mac app called Guest House. A friend of mine, Amena Thomas, develops it, so I'm not neutral, but I think a lot of people here will want to know it exists. Guest House sets up and runs virtual machines on a Mac, and it is built for VoiceOver users from the start. You can install Windows 11 without sighted help at any step. The app speaks what it is doing through VoiceOver, and when something goes wrong it tells you what happened and what to do next. What it does: - **Windows 11 for ARM:** Guest House can download Windows straight from Microsoft, answer the setup questions for you, and install it. - **A screen reader from the first sign-in:** it can install NVDA for you, and JAWS if you choose it. JAWS needs your own license. - **Linux:** Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, Kali, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux and openSUSE Tumbleweed install with no installer questions, with Orca speaking from the first boot. - **macOS:** it can also run macOS virtual machines. - **Braille displays:** you can pass a USB braille display through to Windows. - **Windows apps in Command-Tab:** your Windows apps can appear in the Mac's app switcher. - **Control-Alt keys with VoiceOver on:** VoiceOver keeps Control-Option for itself, so you hold Command-Option instead. Command-Option-Right Arrow reaches Windows as Control-Alt-Right Arrow. - **Everyday extras:** copy and paste between the Mac and Windows, a shared folder, restore points, and a list of Windows apps it can install for you. What you should know: - It needs a Mac with Apple silicon. It does not run on Intel Macs. - It is free and open source, under the GPL version 2. - It is still in early testing, so you may find bugs. Help > Report a Problem puts a report on the clipboard and opens a new issue for you to paste it into. - It grew out of Allison Meloy's Accessible Virtual Machine, and builds on her work. I have been testing this and Amena has been incredibly responsive fixing a show-stopping issue for my specific use case very quickly once reported. She is keen for any feedback so please don't hesitate to get in touch. You can download it and read more here: https://fullcircleat.com/guest-house/

title: Beasties: Offline Puzzle Games
summary: Sort puzzles and brain teasers with monsters, offline and without a single ad. 19 games, over 75,000 levels: Gnatz and the gang are waiting for you. STACKS: THE SORT PUZZLE Move the monsters from pole to pole until every pole holds just one family. Sleepy monsters only wake up when they reach the top. Every level can be solved, and the fewer moves you need, the more stars you win. MORE GAMES TO PLAY • Triple Trouble: swap monsters and line up three of a kind. • Tile Pile: pick tiles off the pile and match three on your bench. • Bumper Cars: tap the cars out of the arena without a single crash. • Laundry Day: hang three matching socks on one line. • Block Munch: place the pieces, fill lines and clear the fog. • Hive Stacks: drop monster stacks on the honeycomb, and ten of a kind get gobbled up. • Paint Trail: swipe, and the monster paints every tile it slides over. • Ice Slide: tilt the pond and slide every monster into its own nest. • Colour Gulp: pick a shade, and the slime gulps every matching tile it touches. BRAIN TEASERS • Sudoku: 1 to 9 once in every row, column and box. Always one solution. • Nonogram: paint cells by the number clues and a pixel monster appears. • Mines: use the numbers to find every monster asleep under the tiles, without waking one. • Dens: one monster per den, never two in a row or column, never touching. • Number Bite: keep the digits that make the sums, and Gnatz munches the rest. • Cage Sums: sudoku with dashed cages, the digits in each cage add up to its sum. • Number Pairs: clear pairs that are equal or make 10 until the field is empty. • Number Cross: a crossword with digits, every line adds up to its clue. • Goo Pipes: turn the pipes until the goo reaches every hungry monster, without a leak. AT YOUR OWN PACE • No ads, ever, not even for a hint • Plays offline: on the train, on a plane, at the bottom of the garden • No account, no sign-up • No timer, no lives, no waiting • Four difficulties: Chill, Normal, Tricky and Devilish • Three daily challenges, every day YOUR MONSTER, YOUR STYLE Win stars, hatch eggs and dress up your monster in the monster workshop: hats, eyes, horns, patterns and more. The free season pass adds parts you can only get that season. BEASTIES PRO Every game has 150 free levels on each of Chill, Normal and Tricky, and you can unlock more with stars. A one-time purchase unlocks all 999 levels per difficulty in every game, the Devilish difficulty and 500 bonus stars. No subscription, and it works with Family Sharing. An idea or a problem? Tap "Write feedback" in the app. We read every message.

Buy a pack once and keep it forever.

title: Unraveled - Ravelry Companion
summary: Unraveled is an independent third-party client for Ravelry. It's the fastest way to manage your projects, browse patterns, organize your stash, get inspiration, and keep up with your queue. Beautifully designed for iPhone and iPad. Built to get out of your way so you can spend more time doing what you love most. WHAT YOU GET • Projects — view, edit, add photos, and note every project. Track status, progress, gauge, needles, hooks, and yarn. • Queue — what's next, prioritized your way. Quick-add from any pattern. • Stash & Library — your yarn, patterns, and purchase history, fully searchable. • Favorites & Bundles — collect patterns by project, season, or theme. • Search — the full filter set: craft, weight, fiber type, sort, and dozens more, in a native iOS interface. • Messages & Friends — your messages and friend activity, on the go. • Widgets — projects, queue, stash, and Hot Right Now widgets in every size, right in your home screen. Tap to jump straight into the right place. • iPad Sidebar — adaptive split view for browsing patterns and projects side by side. • Quick Actions — press and hold any project, pattern, or stash item for a shortcut menu of common things you'd do next. • Ravelry your way — reorder filters and tabs so you can get to what you care about quicker than ever. • Built for iOS 26 — Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, VoiceOver, Reduced Motion, and Spotlight deep links throughout. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ADS. NO TRACKING. Unraveled is free for 14 days with full access to every feature. After the trial, a one-time $7.99 unlock gives you lifetime access. No recurring fees. No advertising. No third-party tracking. Just a beautifully made tool that gets out of your way so you can get back to crafting. “I just downloaded your app and it's stunning. It's the first app I've seen that really looks like Ravelry!” — Michelle “That was quick... 3 minutes to download and update my latest projects with photos. I'd never do that in a browser while waiting for food on Market Street!” — Emily, San Francisco “Finally! A well designed Ravelry app for Apple devices!!” — Brittany Download now and find out what all the hype is about!

title: Spellweaver's Deck: Roguelike
summary: A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where the story changes the cards in your hand. Built for one-thumb portrait play on iPhone. Pay once. No ads, no energy, no pay-to-win. The Hush is spreading through Vessany, taking voices, then names, then the people who owned them. You are a Spellweaver. You bind spells, oaths and memories into a grimoire of cards, and you set out from the Loom to learn what the silence wants. Every run is a new weave. Every choice leaves a thread behind. FOUR SPELLWEAVERS, FOUR WAYS TO FIGHT • Ashbinder – stoke Ember and let Burn do the killing. • Warden – raise Barriers, swear Oaths, and make every blow cost them. • Veilsinger – sow Dread, Echo your best spells, Exhaust what you no longer need. • Bonecaller – spend Bone Shards and your own blood, then hex the weakened. Almost 400 cards to collect and play, dozens of relics, dual-path upgrades, and Inscriptions that rewrite every card they touch. Read enemy intents, plan the turn, drag a card onto or tap and select its target. COMPANIONS WHO REMEMBER Recruit allies who bring their own gift cards and a once-per-fight intervention you trigger from the battle screen. Earn their devotion and they fight harder. Lose their trust and they leave, and the card they gave you curdles into a Regret curse in your deck. Every companion has a fate waiting on the ending screen. A WORLD THAT TALKS BACK More than a hundred story events across three acts. Bosses and elites speak when you meet them, when they turn, and when they die. Choices you made in Act I send their invoices in Act III. Multiple endings, and secrets past them. THE LOOM REMEMBERS Fall, and bind one earned card to the Loom for the next Weaver to carry. Spend Threads on new classes, cards, relics and boons. Climb ten levels of Weave Depth. Stack Trials for a higher score multiplier. Watch the tapestry gain a band with every victory, and the sky over the Loom remember how you ended. MORE WAYS TO WEAVE • Daily Weave – one seed for everyone, with rival ghosts showing where they fell. • Weekly Gauntlet – a named modifier stack, three attempts, a recurring leaderboard. • The Tolling – six bells, elite to boss, about twelve minutes. • Loomcast – draft your grimoire before you set out. • Seeded practice – any seed, any unlocked depth. MADE FOR IPHONE, WORKS ON IPAD Portrait, one-thumb, drag-to-target. Haptics, floating numbers, screen shake, and a full score with act, boss, shop and rest themes. Autosave and resume at any moment. Game Center leaderboards and achievements. iCloud backup of your progress. Plays offline. FAIR BY DESIGN Buy it once and the whole game is yours. The optional extras are cosmetic: card backs, card faces, tapestry themes, thread dyes. Nothing you can buy changes a card, a drop rate, or a difficulty. Money never buys balance. The world is falling silent. What will you weave?

title: Still: Breathing Exercises

Choose a quiet reset, refocus between tasks, or make a little room as you wind down. Follow one living ring with visual cues and gentle haptics. No account needed. BOX AND 4-7-8 BREATHING, FREE Two well-known named rhythms, free at 3 and 5 minutes. Box Breathing: 4 in · 4 hold · 4 out · 4 pause. 4-7-8 Breathing: 4 in · 7 hold · 8 out. Holds are gentle and optional, the voice stays silent while you hold, and you can breathe out early at any time. Box Breathing also comes as a 10-minute session with Premium; 4-7-8 Breathing is offered at 3 and 5 minutes. START FREE Repeat the six free practices as often as you like. Soft rain and noise backgrounds, personal practice history, and history backups through Files or iCloud Drive stay free. Full English voice guidance is part of Still Premium; free 30-second samples let you hear it before subscribing. FIND YOUR RHYTHM Clear visual cues and gentle haptics guide each practice. Preview the English voice with free 30-second samples. Breathe comfortably and return to your own pace whenever you need to. EXPLORE STILL PREMIUM Make more room for your practice with the complete library of 26 practices, 3-, 5-, and 10-minute sessions, all 10 soundscapes, English voice guidance, and four guided collections. Every subscription plan includes the same Premium access. Anyone can browse the collections, and days built on free practices can be started without Premium. KEEP A QUIET HISTORY See your completed sessions, minutes, weekly rhythm, and streaks. Your practice history is stored locally, with optional synchronization through your private iCloud database. READY OFFLINE Practices and audio are bundled in the app. Buying or restoring Premium needs an internet connection; verified, active Premium access supports offline practice. The app interface is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Portuguese (Brazil); voice guidance is in English. No advertising or cross-app tracking. Apple and RevenueCat process purchases and subscription-related information, as described in our Privacy Policy. Still Premium is an optional auto-renewable subscription. Plans, prices, and billing periods are shown before purchase. Eligible subscribers may receive a free trial on the weekly or yearly plan; the renewal price and billing period are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Still provides general-wellness breathing and mindfulness content, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Stop if you feel unwell or uncomfortable. Do not practice while driving, in water, or during an activity requiring your full attention. title: Teddy Dreams: Match 3 Puzzle

Swap teddy bears to make matches, collect level goals, and use powerful bonus items like Blanket Rockets, Pillow Pops, Honey Hearts, and Sparkle Stars. Every level brings a fresh goal: clear special bears, break sleepy obstacles, collect memory cards, rescue falling stars, or survive playful gravity changes. FEATURES • Match colorful teddy bears in quick, satisfying levels • Use cozy bonuses and huge combo clears • Clear Pillow Blocks, Blanket Knots, Toy Boxes, and Dream Fog • Play unlimited journey levels with rising challenge • Try daily challenges and build win streaks • Unlock new teddy styles with useful perks • Follow Teddy across a dreamy level map • Enjoy readable goals, soft animations, and gentle fail states Teddy Dreams is made for short puzzle sessions that still feel magical. Plan smart swaps, set up bonuses, and help Teddy bring light back to each cozy dream.
